build_entity_prefab: build an Entity prefab that wraps a language model as a Concordia agent with a configurable system prompt
build_entity_with_custom_prompt: build an Entity agent with a custom system prompt and name via the params mapping
build_entity_with_memory_bank: build an Entity agent that uses an associative memory bank for context and observation history
review_entity_build_method: review the Entity build method to understand how system, observation, and memory components are assembled
refactor_entity_params: refactor the Entity params mapping to add a custom name or system prompt for the simulated assistant
